ask: can u make a timeline of the trip from all the dates and places we said
sentence: Shows a day-by-day list of a trip's dates and plans that anyone in the group can add to, edit, move or remove, with a button for each person to mark that the plan looks right.
use_when: The group wants one shared timeline built from dates and places already mentioned in chat
Someone asks for a trip itinerary or schedule by day
The group needs to check together that the plan is correct
Plans for a multi-day trip keep changing and need one place to fix them
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote between options such as places or dates
The group needs to split costs or track who owes what
The group needs a packing list or to-do list with assigned tasks
